notes.title: Nioh 3 Launches on 6th February 2026 - pre-order now!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/477dbf3f1d67dd36d491ecaedf827961d2a751ec.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]The latest installment of the dark Sengoku action RPG series, Nioh 3, is set to release on Friday, February 6, 2026![/h3][p][/p][p]Digital pre-order begin today, and check the official website to see the latest information on key characters, game system, and various bonuses![/p][p][/p][p]Official website: [url="https://teamninja-studio.com/nioh3/"]https://teamninja-studio.com/nioh3/[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WCWrQbn4Uvk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Release Date Announcement Trailer depicting the story and world of Nioh 3 is now available! Directed by Shinji Higuchi, this trailer showcases the battle between the protagonist Tokugawa Takechiyo, who has been ousted from the position of shogun, and his younger brother Tokugawa Kunimatsu, while featuring a dynamic story that transcends time.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/74d2cefe6146c97c57d78a9f56f8f1f86e57d78f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/823d3731edc80bd41d30f9240631d55406ac9c53.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/4192166e6c841aab20b4c6f440315abace9ac9c3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/b6c1da0a833c4726b328e356b38d12811818c6d5.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]■Nioh 3 Story Outline[/h3][p]The year is Genna 8 (1622).  [/p][p]Edo Castle stands on the brink of the protagonist Tokugawa Takechiyo's imminent appointment as the next shogun.[/p][p]Takechiyo's younger brother, Tokugawa Kunimatsu, consumed by hatred toward his brother's succession, falls into darkness.  [/p][p]Empowered by a sinister force, he leads a horde of yokai in a fierce assault against Takechiyo. [/p][p]The era of peace suddenly turns into hell, and in dire straits, Takechiyo transcends time through the mysterious power of his guardian spirit, Kusanagi.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/c4bb78328857c0877ac7a30d1bd39a46f0ef843f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/29fa0ac75ac00a279e588d41df290c6429ae62eb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/928e03ed08b2b108767af44db77c3ac1ed538ef2.jpg"][/img] [/p][h3]■A tale of battles across Edo, Sengoku, and Heian periods[/h3][p]Starting from Edo Castle, the story takes players through various worlds across different periods including Sengoku’s Totomi and the Heian capital Kyoto. Players will meet diverse characters, face formidable enemies, and uncover the truth behind the story in this epic adventure. Each era is represented by unique and fantastical open-field environments. Different yokai, powerful enemies, and the Crucible stand in protagonist Takechiyo’s path. The official website also features videos of era as well as information about various yokai. Look forward to Nioh 3, delivering the largest-scale narrative and world in the franchise to date.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/947a31146b37329476ecba02c1093a3cf2d872c8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/8b65648b7e7432e0e07089925d3979571aaea4a4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/6a66507cd79591df249367992e69ef5992b76c5f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/1c96e880983eb1f759ac6c6640787f66a111e931.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647226/974aac04db24cfc23e3f3e0dfec6ac398ea9572a.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Nioh 3's release date reportedly leaks via Amazon Japan ahead of PlayStation State of Play
notes.notes:
Update: As suspected, Sony have confirmed the leaked PS5 release date in their latest State of Play. Koei Tecmo have elsewhere announced that it's coming to PC on the same day.

Original story continues below:

Whoops, action RPG Nioh 3's release date has reportedly leaked via some swiftly pulled Amazon Japan listings. The apparent leak, which precedes a PlayStation State of Play showcase set for later today (September 24th), has also laid bare some deets as to what the game's swankier Treasure Box Edition includes.

notes.title: Nioh 3 officially revealed - and it's not a PlayStation exclusive, even if there's a demo you can only play on PS5
notes.notes:
As part of the PlayStation State of Play, we got treated to the surprise reveal of the next game in the Nioh action RPG series. It’s simply titled Nioh 3, and it’s going to be changing so much of what we know about Nioh.

notes.title: "Nioh 3" announced for early 2026
notes.notes:
With over 8 million units sold worldwide, the popular "Nioh" series welcomes its new title, "Nioh 3", in early 2026!

"Nioh 3" will not only be the first open-field entry in the series, but it will also include two different fighting styles ("Samurai" and "Ninja"), which can be easily alternated mid-battle, allowing players to further enjoy this dark samurai action-RPG.

During the era of samurai, our protagonist will have to face this turbulent period while carrying the weight of being the next Shogun.

Stay tuned for more information!
